peer_results.rationale: AMD's candidates focus on hardware sales (CPUs, GPUs, DPUs) to hyperscale providers for AI and general web applications (D057) or networking offload (D025). While AVGO also serves cloud/telecom operators, AVGO's specific topic is a Telco Cloud Platform solution for infrastructure modernization and service monetization via automation, which is a distinct software/platform strategy compared to AMD's hardware-centric component sales and offload technologies.

Intel's candidates focus on its x86 ecosystem strategy (D006) and supply chain positioning (D004). These topics concern architectural foundations and manufacturing capacity, which are structurally different from AVGO's specific disclosure of a Telco Cloud Platform product for telecom operator infrastructure modernization.

comparisons.peer_summary: CNBU data center sales were driven by server demand in cloud and enterprise markets, with growth fueled by the shift of infrastructure and workloads to the cloud and the memory-intensive nature of AI data-centric workloads.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures address the shift of infrastructure and workloads to the cloud as a key business driver. AVGO highlights that its Telco Cloud Platform allows operators to onboard and deliver services faster across domains, facilitating operational agility in cloud-like environments. MU explicitly states that overall cloud growth is driven by the shift of infrastructure and workloads from on-premises to the cloud, and that cloud-native workloads are drivers of growth. Both companies identify the migration to cloud-based architectures as a fundamental demand generator.

sentences.text: • Telco Cloud Platform: This solution supports network operations for telecom operators and communications service providers to modernize their infrastructure and allows them to create monetizable services. The modernization of the telecom infrastructure is critical to enabling operational agility, onboarding and delivering services much faster across domains and simplifying operations with automation.
Overall cloud growth continues to be driven by the shift of both infrastructure and workloads from on-premises to the cloud.

Cloud-native workloads are drivers of growth through use-cases like intelligent edge devices capable of AI and augmented reality that store and access data in the cloud or rely on the cloud for compute capability.

comparisons.peer_summary: In fiscal year 2024, NVIDIA launched DGX Cloud, an AI-training-as-a-service platform providing cloud-based infrastructure, software, customizable pretrained models, and expert access, hosted in partnership with leading cloud service providers.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and NVIDIA describe launching new platform-based services in fiscal 2024 that provide infrastructure and software to service providers. AVGO's Telco Cloud Platform supports telecom operators to modernize infrastructure and create monetizable services, while NVIDIA launched DGX Cloud as an AI-training-as-a-service platform providing cloud-based infrastructure and software. Both disclosures highlight partnerships with cloud service providers to host these services, though AVGO focuses on telecom infrastructure modernization and NVIDIA on AI-specific training workloads.

sentences.text: • Telco Cloud Platform: This solution supports network operations for telecom operators and communications service providers to modernize their infrastructure and allows them to create monetizable services. The modernization of the telecom infrastructure is critical to enabling operational agility, onboarding and delivering services much faster across domains and simplifying operations with automation.

In fiscal year 2024, we launched the NVIDIA DGX Cloud, an AI-training-as-a-service platform which includes cloud-based infrastructure and software for AI, customizable pretrained AI models, and access to NVIDIA experts.
We have partnered with leading cloud service providers to host this service in their data centers.

comparisons.peer_summary: Leading cloud service providers and consumer internet companies utilize NVIDIA's data-center-scale accelerated computing platforms to enable and enrich services for billions of end users, including AI assistants and search.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and NVIDIA disclose that their solutions are utilized by leading cloud service providers to deliver services to end users. AVGO's Telco Cloud Platform enables telecom operators (who are often large communications service providers) to modernize infrastructure and deliver services faster, while NVIDIA explicitly states that leading cloud service providers use its accelerated computing platforms to enable and enrich services for billions of end users, including AI assistants. The common thread is the reliance on cloud/communication service provider ecosystems to deploy infrastructure and enable customer-facing services.

sentences.text: • Telco Cloud Platform: This solution supports network operations for telecom operators and communications service providers to modernize their infrastructure and allows them to create monetizable services. The modernization of the telecom infrastructure is critical to enabling operational agility, onboarding and delivering services much faster across domains and simplifying operations with automation.

The world's leading cloud service providers, or CSPs, and consumer internet companies use our data center-scale accelerated computing platforms to enable, accelerate or enrich the services they deliver to billions of end users, including AI solutions and assistants, search, recommendations, social networking, online shopping, live video, and translation.
